task: Harden the receipts CI workflow: add a job timeout and remove the stale root receipt-input.json left over from a previous PR
plan: No visual surface to this change — it's entirely CI/workflow config. Emit a reasoning-only receipt (no acceptanceCriteria, no targetUrl) so the pipeline still runs end to end (presence check, QA's reasoning-only path, the inline-preview fallback commit, and the PR comment) without needing to boot the web app.
decisions: Removed the root receipt-input.json rather than updating it in place, since a stale one describing a merged PR's task would keep getting picked up by every future PR's CI otherwise
Added timeout-minutes: 15 to the job as cheap insurance against a hung ffmpeg/dev-server process
rejectedAlternatives: Leaving the old receipt-input.json in place and just updating its prNumber each time — more error-prone than removing it and letting each PR that wants a receipt add its own

promptLog.text: Make a new PR, that one is already merged.
Restarting the branch from main and opening a small, real hardening PR that also exercises the receipts CI pipeline itself (including the new reasoning-only path) as a side effect.
